positions.title: Developer
positions.description: Working at Neo has shown me a new world other than just development. As a product team, we focused primarily on validating ideas and building startups from the ground up. I've not only grown technologically but I've had a glimpse of what it takes to actually start a successful startup.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description: Wizard Development makes Products and Development Teams strong. We're a team of product managers, developers, and designers. Our philosophy is success through education. We teach you how to get the most value from your work and and from your software.

positions.title: Junior Ruby on Rails Developer
positions.description:
•	Building various applications using Rails and 3rd party APIs.
•	Using Thoughtbot’s style guide and best practices including refactoring and design patterns.
•	Creating dynamic pages through Javascript, JQuery, and AJAX.
•	Submitting and reviewing pull requests on GitHub, providing and receiving positive criticisms.

positions.title: PSI Analyst
positions.description:
•	Analyze current demand and sales to meet output goals.
•	Evaluate logistics data to provide support to reach shipment targets.
•	Generate reports for upper management and the CFO to provide information regarding sales status and demand.
•	Provided crucial support for LG’s G3 launch; the company’s most successful model to date.

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description:
•	Developed scripts in VBA to convert over 100,000 experiments in Excel to Roche’s BioBook protocols.
•	Designed a BioBook plug-in to remediate over 600 experiments done in outdated BioBook protocols to current protocols.
•	Created Python scripts to extract metadata from experiments done in Chem Book and create a memory efficient database.
